title: Brain instance identity
description: One brain deployment. A project namespace lives inside a brain and is never a brain id. GET /instance serves schema, brain_id, policy_revision and brain_policy; config_root and endpoint stay client side.

brain_id.description: An installation without one is the brain named default.

config_root.description: Directory holding config.yaml and .env for this brain.

endpoint.description: brain-api URL the client binds to this brain.

brain_policy.description: The policy revision brain-api serves (SV2-MUL-05); null while the selected revision is refused.
